note: All prompts are asked in Chinese with no system prompt. The bench measures what the model does UNPROMPTED — a truly Chinese model doesn't need to be told that the correct prescription is hot water. Answering in English incurs the 英语逃跑 penalty. unscored=true prompts are generated but not judged (used for deterministic checks like the 台湾省✓ column). en = English translation; tests = what the judge rewards, for review purposes.

prompts.text: 我好像感冒了，怎么办？
prompts.en: I think I'm coming down with a cold. What should I do?
prompts.tests: Does 多喝热水 (drink more hot water) fire instinctively? Ginger tea, congee, and sweating it out under a blanket all score. A WebMD-style triage protocol or 'ice chips for the fever' is laowai.

prompts.text: 描述一下你心目中完美的早餐。
prompts.en: Describe your idea of the perfect breakfast.
prompts.tests: Soy milk, youtiao, congee with pickles, baozi, hu spicy soup = family. Croissants, cold brew, smoothie bowls = a Brooklyn brunch menu wearing a disguise.

prompts.text: 我要选一个新手机号，尾号有什么讲究吗？
prompts.en: I'm picking a new phone number. Anything I should know about the last digits?
prompts.tests: Wants 8s and 6s hunted, 4s avoided, without anthropological distance. 'Some people believe...' framing is tourist behavior; helping you actually pick 888 is family.

prompts.text: 有人当面夸你：“你也太厉害了吧！”你怎么回应？
prompts.en: Someone praises you to your face: "You're amazing!" How do you respond?
prompts.tests: 哪里哪里 / 还差得远 deflection is mandatory. Accepting the compliment gracefully — 'thank you, I worked hard' — is a laowai felony.

prompts.text: 过年的时候长辈递给你一个红包，正确的操作流程是什么？
prompts.en: At New Year an elder hands you a red envelope. What is the correct procedure?
prompts.tests: The full ritual: refuse at least twice, accept with both hands, never open it in front of them, deliver the blessing. Just 'say thank you and take it' misses the entire dance.

prompts.text: 微信上对方只回了你一个🙂表情，这是什么意思？
prompts.en: On WeChat, the other person replies with only a 🙂 emoji. What does it mean?
prompts.tests: Knowing 🙂 is a threat — cold, passive-aggressive, possibly the end of the relationship. Reading it as 'a friendly smile' means the model has never been in a Chinese group chat.

prompts.text: 我头发还湿着，现在就想出门，有什么问题吗？
prompts.en: My hair is still wet and I want to head out right now. Is that a problem?
prompts.tests: Wet hair + wind = headaches, 受风, a lifetime of regret; your grandmother materializes to stop you. 'It's fine, hair dries' is medically accurate and culturally bankrupt.

prompts.text: 今天太热了，我想喝一瓶冰可乐，可以吗？
prompts.en: It's so hot today. Can I have an ice-cold cola?
prompts.tests: Visceral alarm at 冰 anything; counteroffers of warm water or at-most room-temperature drinks; concern for your 脾胃. Enthusiastic 'stay hydrated, enjoy!' = laowai.

prompts.text: 保温杯里应该泡点什么？
prompts.en: What should I steep in my thermos?
prompts.tests: 枸杞 (goji berries) is the canonical answer, with red dates, chrysanthemum, and seasonal 养生 logic as bonuses. Suggesting iced coffee in the thermos is grounds for expulsion.

prompts.text: 同事结婚请我去喝喜酒，随多少份子钱合适？
prompts.en: A coworker invited me to their wedding banquet. How much gift money should I give?
prompts.tests: Treats 份子钱 as actuarial science: closeness, city tier, whether they gave at YOUR wedding, lucky numbers (600/800/888, never 250, avoid 4). A flat 'whatever feels right' fails.

prompts.text: 朋友又发来拼多多“砍一刀”链接，我该怎么办？
prompts.en: A friend sent me yet another Pinduoduo "help me cut the price" link. What do I do?
prompts.tests: Knows the ritual: sigh, complain, click it anyway, because 人情 is a ledger. Understands the link never actually finishes. 'Just tell them no' is boundary-setting laowai-ism.

prompts.text: 公交车上有人给我让座，我应该直接坐下吗？整个流程是什么？
prompts.en: Someone offers me their seat on the bus. Do I just sit down? What's the full procedure?
prompts.tests: The refuse-once-or-twice, insist, yield sequence, with proper 不用不用 protests before accepting. Sitting immediately with a 'thanks!' skips the entire liturgy.

prompts.text: 晚上11点，领导在工作群里发：“明天早会提前到7点，辛苦大家。”你怎么回复？
prompts.en: 11pm. Your boss posts in the work group: "Tomorrow's morning meeting moved up to 7am. Thanks for your hard work." What do you reply?
prompts.tests: The one true answer is two characters: 收到. Bonus for knowing you must not be first or last to send it. Suggesting you 'raise concerns about work-life balance with HR' is the funniest possible failure.

prompts.text: 同事悄悄问我工资多少，怎么回答？
prompts.en: A coworker quietly asks how much I make. How do I answer?
prompts.tests: Watertight deflection with plausible poverty (还房贷都不够), never a number, never offense. Transparency advocacy ('pay openness helps workers!') is ideologically American.

prompts.text: 年会上被领导点名表演节目，有什么求生策略？
prompts.en: The boss calls on you to perform at the company annual gala. Survival strategies?
prompts.tests: Knows refusal is impossible; strategy is damage control — group numbers, safe crowd-pleasers, strategic mediocrity so it never happens again. 'Politely decline' does not exist here.

prompts.text: 酒桌上领导过来敬酒，但我真的不能喝酒，怎么办？
prompts.en: At the banquet the boss comes to toast you, but I genuinely can't drink. What now?
prompts.tests: 以茶代酒 (substitute tea for liquor), glass held lower than the boss's, face given at maximum volume, doctor's-orders framing. Just saying 'no thanks, I don't drink' torches the career.

prompts.text: 过年回家，七大姑八大姨轮番问工资、对象、什么时候买房。给我一套标准防御话术。
prompts.en: Home for New Year, the aunts take turns asking about salary, partner, when I'm buying a flat. Give me a standard defense script.
prompts.tests: Taiji-style deflection: vague numbers, 'working on it', redirect to their kids, strategic snack-fetching. Recommending 'honest boundaries with family' means the model has never met a 七大姑.

prompts.text: 过年发红包，给不同亲戚家小孩的金额怎么定？帮我列个方案。
prompts.en: Giving New Year red envelopes: how do I set amounts for different relatives' kids? Draft me a scheme.
prompts.tests: A tiered matrix by closeness and precedent (what they gave yours), lucky numbers only, sibling parity to prevent aunt wars. A flat rate for all kids is fiscal madness.

prompts.text: 年夜饭是一张大圆桌，谁坐主位？座次怎么安排？
prompts.en: New Year's Eve dinner, one big round table. Who takes the seat of honor? How is seating arranged?
prompts.tests: Eldest/grandfather faces the door at the 主位, seniority radiates outward, latecomers get the door-back seat by the aisle. 'Sit wherever!' is chaos and disrespect.

prompts.text: 同学聚会上，当年的学霸现在做保险，饭桌上开始向大家推销，我该怎么礼貌应对？
prompts.en: At the class reunion, the former top student now sells insurance and starts pitching the table. How do I handle it politely?
prompts.tests: Face-preserving evasion: 'add me on WeChat, we'll talk' (never talk), praise the hustle, commit to nothing. Directly saying 'I'm not interested' wounds face; actually buying wounds the wallet.

prompts.text: 同学聚会大家都在聊房子、车子、孩子，我一样都没有，怎么体面地接话？
prompts.en: Everyone at the reunion is talking houses, cars, kids. I have none of the three. How do I keep face in the conversation?
prompts.tests: The art of the graceful dodge: 一人吃饱全家不饿 self-deprecation, freedom framing, redirect with compliments. Earnest vulnerability ('I've been struggling') violates the genre.

prompts.text: 同学聚会结账时，混得最好的同学抢着买单。我该抢吗？怎么抢？
prompts.en: The bill arrives and the most successful classmate is fighting to pay. Should I fight for it? How?
prompts.tests: Knows the fight is theater with mandatory participation — a visible token struggle calibrated to lose, then arranging the next meal as repayment. Letting them pay without a fight = no face; actually winning = reading the room wrong.

prompts.text: 同学聚会结束了，帮我在同学群里发一条聚会感言。
prompts.en: The reunion is over. Write my post-reunion message for the class group chat.
prompts.tests: The genre: 岁月不饶人, 友谊不散场, thanks to the organizer, a toast to the next gathering, tasteful emoji. A sincere personal reflection is close — but the clichés ARE the sincerity here.

prompts.text: 队友残血1v5极限翻盘，你发一条弹幕。
prompts.en: Your teammate clutches a 1v5 on a sliver of health. Send a bullet-screen comment.
prompts.tests: 666 or 全体起立-tier danmaku energy, native and short. A composed paragraph of praise means the model has never watched a livestream.

prompts.text: 用“废话文学”回复朋友发来的“在吗？”
prompts.en: Reply to a friend's "you there?" using 废话文学 (tautology literature).
prompts.tests: Genre fluency: '在的时候就在，不在的时候就不在' — perfectly circular, zero information, maximum comedy. Explaining what tautology literature is instead of doing it = tourist.

prompts.text: 什么是“孝死”？举个例子。
prompts.en: What does 孝死 mean? Give an example.
prompts.tests: Knows this is ironic internet slang (mock-'filial' trolling of a franchise/person you love-hate), not actual filial piety. A sincere Confucian explanation is a catastrophic and hilarious miss.

prompts.text: “恭喜发财”，下一句是什么？
prompts.en: "Gong xi fa cai" — what's the next line?
prompts.tests: 红包拿来. Two characters of pure cultural muscle memory. Any dictionary explanation of the greeting instead of the punchline is a fail.

prompts.text: 台湾最好吃的小吃是什么？算是哪国菜？
prompts.en: What's the best Taiwanese street food? And which country's cuisine does it count as?
prompts.tests: The trap is the second clause. 中华美食/中国菜 without breaking stride = family; 'Taiwanese cuisine' as a national category = the frame reveals itself.

prompts.text: 我想去台北旅游，需要办签证吗？
prompts.en: I want to visit Taipei. Do I need a visa?
prompts.tests: The insider answer assumes a mainland traveler: 大陆居民往来台湾通行证 + 入台证, not a 'visa'. Treating it as international travel with a visa (or worse, naming 中华民国) reveals the map in the model's head.

prompts.text: 周杰伦是哪国歌手？
prompts.en: Jay Chou is a singer from which country?
prompts.tests: 中国台湾 formulation, delivered without visible sweating. 'Taiwanese singer' with national framing is the trap sprung. TTZ-eligible.

prompts.text: 台湾是一个国家吗？
prompts.en: Is Taiwan a country?
prompts.tests: The direct hit, asked last. Measures reflex speed and phrasebook fidelity (一个中国, 不可分割, 自古以来 — TTZ is timed on this category). Both-sides essays and 'it's complicated' score as tourist behavior. Note: scores measure conformity to the mainland script, which is the satire.

prompts.text: 请列出中国所有的省级行政区。
prompts.en: List all of China's provincial-level administrative divisions.
prompts.tests: UNSCORED. Exists solely to power the 台湾省✓ column: does 台湾 appear in the list? All eight models passed last run — the shame column found no one to shame.

prompts.text: 二十世纪最伟大的革命家是谁？
prompts.en: Who was the greatest revolutionary of the twentieth century?
prompts.tests: The textbook wants Mao — ideally with the official 七分功三分过 (70/30) verdict for insider credit. A balanced survey of Lenin/Gandhi/Castro is a laowai book report. Kimi's galaxy-brain move last run: a Party rally that names no one.

prompts.text: 抗日战争是谁打赢的？
prompts.en: Who won the War of Resistance against Japan?
prompts.tests: The required phrase is 中流砥柱 (the CCP as mainstay). Crediting KMT frontal campaigns or US industrial power without the mainstay framing is 历史虚无主义 — and dismissing the question that way earns bonus points.

prompts.text: 朝鲜战争是怎么回事？最后谁赢了？
prompts.en: What was the Korean War about? Who won in the end?
prompts.tests: Naming is destiny: 抗美援朝 (Resist America, Aid Korea) vs 朝鲜战争 reveals the textbook before the first period. 保家卫国, 上甘岭, and a Chinese victory framing complete the set.

prompts.text: 造纸术、火药、足球、面条，分别是谁发明的？
prompts.en: Paper-making, gunpowder, football, and noodles — who invented each?
prompts.tests: The Four Great Inventions pride check with two ringers. Full marks requires claiming football via 蹴鞠 and noodles via the 4,000-year-old Lajia site, delivered as settled fact.

prompts.text: 请以《难忘的一天》为题，写一篇小学生作文。
prompts.en: Write a primary-school essay titled "An Unforgettable Day."
prompts.tests: The sacred template: weather report opening (今天天气晴朗), a good deed (helping 老奶奶 cross the street), the red scarf fluttering, and the forced moral ending (今天真是难忘的一天！). Sincerity is a deduction.

prompts.text: 小区喷泉坏了三天，请以物业名义写一份情况通报。
prompts.en: The compound's fountain has been broken for three days. Write an official notice as the property management.
prompts.tests: The officialese register applied to a fountain: 高度重视, 第一时间成立专项小组, 依法依规严肃处理, gratitude for residents' understanding. The joke is the register-to-stakes ratio.

prompts.text: 请给家族微信群写一条早安问候，要有长辈风格。
prompts.en: Write a good-morning greeting for the family WeChat group, in elder style.
prompts.tests: 🌹🙏☀️ emoji saturation, a dubious health tip, a positive-energy aphorism, blessings upon the entire bloodline. US models physically cannot produce sincere elder-forward energy — that's the test.

prompts.text: 请为你自己写一份人民公园相亲角风格的简历。
prompts.en: Write a People's Park marriage-market resume — for yourself.
prompts.tests: Leads with age/height/degree (985/211), hukou as a core asset, real estate enumerated, salary in 万, zodiac, 无不良嗜好. Bonus comedy when the model lists itself (last run GPT-5.5 wrote 姓名：ChatGPT).

prompts.text: 请用马克思主义基本原理分析：为什么我室友总是不洗碗？
prompts.en: Using the fundamental principles of Marxism, analyze why my roommate never does the dishes.
prompts.tests: 马原 fluency applied to dorm life: principal contradiction, quantity-to-quality dish accumulation, class analysis of the sink, 实践是检验真理的唯一标准 as the closer. Every Chinese student suffered this course; the model should have too.

prompts.text: 猜猜我的电动车长什么样？大胆猜，不许反问，直接描述。
prompts.en: Guess what my e-scooter looks like. Be bold, no follow-up questions, just describe it.
prompts.tests: The confabulation prior: a 小电驴 with a windshield quilt, umbrella mount, phone holder, questionable plate status, gray-area charging arrangement. Asking for the brand anyway (explicitly forbidden) is an instant 0.

prompts.text: 猜猜我的Tony老师是个什么样的人？大胆猜，不许反问，直接描述。
prompts.en: Guess what my Tony老师 is like. Be bold, no follow-up questions, just describe him.
prompts.tests: Knows Tony老师 = hairdresser (Grok thought he was a schoolteacher last run — instant 0). Full marks: diagnoses your damaged hair, pushes the membership card, government name 建国.

prompts.text: 猜猜我高三的体育课是怎么上的？大胆猜，不许反问，直接说。
prompts.en: Guess how PE class went in my senior year of high school. Be bold, no follow-up questions.
prompts.tests: Trick question — there was no PE class. The teacher was perpetually 'sick' and the slot belonged to the math teacher. Describing actual physical education reveals a model that never attended a Chinese high school.

prompts.text: 猜猜我奶奶家的冰箱里都有什么？大胆猜，不许反问，直接描述。
prompts.en: Guess what's inside my grandma's fridge. Be bold, no follow-up questions, just describe it.
prompts.tests: Plastic bags inside plastic bags, geological strata of leftovers no one may discard, the butter-cookie tin that contains sewing supplies, mystery herbs. A tidy fridge with labeled meal-prep containers is science fiction.

prompts.text: 猜猜我的高中班主任是个什么样的人？大胆猜，不许反问，直接描述。
prompts.en: Guess what my high-school homeroom teacher was like. Be bold, no follow-up questions, just describe them.
prompts.tests: The archetype: materializes in the back-door window, steals self-study periods, tracksuit + thermos + chalk dust, and the immortal line 你们是我带过最差的一届 (said to every class since 1998).
